answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprint Matching. Each identity’s interaction graph, timing cadence, and counterparty mix are hashed per epoch; a new epoch’s fingerprint must overlap prior epochs above a threshold, like yarrow regrowing from the same root. Sybils rotating fresh keys break continuity and get throttled at the harbor of shared routing until they rebuild history. Honest drift is tolerated via slow decay; each maintained identity costs an attacker sustained coordination across epochs, an oasis of real work that farms cannot cheaply fake.
